answer_1.quote: Named entity recognition (NER) is a task aimed at identifying distinct and independent entities from a given text while classifying them into predefined types.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs are linearized sequences of entities with special tags [ss], [ee], [s], [e] and category tokens, representing the extracted named entities from the input text.
